assets.description: Machine-readable knowledge base for pandas standard types, optimization settings, and backend parameters.

best_practices: Never mutate slices of DataFrames without an explicit copy
Never loop over rows with iterrows for computation
Specify explicit usecols and dtypes during I/O reads
Enable Copy-on-Write for future compatibility with pandas 3.0
